userIntent: Design Rivet primary-model task delegation and worker coordination before independent implementation and acceptance.
hypothesis: Rivet should implement a cache-first bounded local coordinator: primary decomposes typed work orders, dispatches isolated headless workers, receives schema-valid result packets, and keeps final authority.

fragments.text: AgentCallbacks is the narrow lifecycle seam between AgentLoop and the outside world.
SessionContext is mutable and push-based; workers must not share primary session history.
Tool.isConcurrencySafe exists but is not used; coordinator can turn it into a real scheduler constraint.
EvidenceState and VerificationMetadata are reusable worker result facts.
Worktree pool maps bounded worker slots to isolated filesystem branches.
Schema-level tool filtering makes unavailable actions structurally impossible for a worker.
Fresh context per worker prevents cross-contamination and keeps result summaries bounded.
Full swarm, federation, and vector learning are too heavy for current Rivet scope.
Erlang intensity/period failure budget escalates upward instead of retrying locally forever.
Kubernetes deduplicating WorkQueue merges repeated keys and keeps per-key execution serialized.
Behavior tree parallel threshold policies map to all_required, first_success, and majority aggregation.
Idempotent reconcile lets interrupted work resume by comparing desired and observed state.
Prefix cache can become the design advantage if workers share system prompt and tool definitions.
Worker structured result packets are an assumption, not a current runtime feature.
Approval gate must be multiplexed by worker identity for asynchronous workers.
Checkpoint semantics do not naturally extend to concurrent worker writes without per-worker isolation.

candidates.name: External CLI worker orchestration
candidates.oneLiner: Primary starts external worker processes in isolated environments and reads back summary files or stdout.
candidates.extinctionReason: It improves external harness orchestration more than Rivet's own runtime capability.

candidates.name: Headless AgentLoop worker pool
candidates.oneLiner: Primary creates isolated headless worker sessions with tool allowlists and model routing, then aggregates schema-valid results.
candidates.advantage: Directly covers decomposition, scheduler, communication, parallel execution, and model routing.

candidates.name: delegate_task tool
candidates.oneLiner: Primary calls a delegation tool that performs a constrained model/research call and returns a structured packet.
candidates.advantage: Good Phase 1 validation path for result schema and primary synthesis.

candidates.name: Shared blackboard self-organizing workers
candidates.oneLiner: Workers claim tasks and write findings to a shared blackboard until completion.
candidates.extinctionReason: Weak stop conditions, authority diffusion, conflict governance, and excessive scope.

finalCandidate.name: Cache-first Bounded Coordinator
principles: structured work orders before smart dispatch
shared system prompt/tool definitions for prefix cache

phases.name: Delegation Contract + Read-only Scout MVP
phases.successCriteria: WorkOrder/WorkerResult schemas pass tests; isolated worker session cannot mutate primary session; read-only allowlist enforced.

phases.name: Coordinator Queue + Cockpit Visibility
phases.successCriteria: WorkOrderQueue supports dedupe/dependencies/failure budget; cockpit shows worker status.

phases.name: Isolated Write Workers + Verification Aggregation
phases.successCriteria: Worker patches are isolated, reviewable, discardable, and verified before application.

phases.name: Adaptive Routing + Learning-lite
phases.successCriteria: Routing reasons are visible and based on model capability plus observed worker reliability.
